brief: @buildthis.bisks.net website that pulls in the entire account and shows the all time top posts in terms of likes, reposts, or replies. It has a leaderboard, anyone who ever uses it has the highest of each count recorded and displayed in a sorted list.
note: built peakposting.bisks.net — scans a whole account for its most-liked/reposted/replied posts, then banks your bests on a shared leaderboard, server-verified so nobody can fake a score.
